title: ICANIAN P9 complete enduro bike current product page
notes: The current exact P9 complete-bike page identifies a Toray T700/T800 frame, recommends 29x2.3 or 27.5x2.8 tires, claims a laterally stiff rear triangle, and lists a 2,400 +/- 20 g frame. The frame-only page instead lists 2,570 +/- 40 g through M and 2,620 +/- 40 g in L, so no single frame weight is selected.
